types.name: UUID
types.description: A v4 UUID string uniquely identifying a task.

types.name: DateString
types.description: An ISO 8601 date string in YYYY-MM-DD format (no time component).

types.name: TimestampTZ
types.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp string with timezone (e.g. 2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z).

types.name: Priority
types.description: An integer representing task priority (1 = default/lowest, higher = more urgent).

types.name: OptionalDateString
types.description: A nullable date string; null indicates no due date is set.

types.name: Task

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the task, generated server-side as a v4 UUID.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The task title; must be a non-empty string.

fields.name: completed
fields.description: Whether the task has been marked as complete.

validators.error_message: Priority must be a positive integer.

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: Optional due date for the task in YYYY-MM-DD format.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Server-generated timestamp of when the task was created.

types.description: The canonical task entity shared across database, backend API, and frontend display.

types.name: TaskList
types.description: An ordered list of Task objects returned by the GET /tasks endpoint.

types.name: CreateTaskRequest

fields.name: title
fields.description: The title for the new task; must be a non-empty string.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Optional priority override; defaults to 1 if omitted.

validators.error_message: Priority must be a positive integer.

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: Optional due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

types.description: Request body for POST /tasks — only title is required; other fields are optional overrides.

types.name: UpdateTaskRequest

fields.name: title
fields.description: New title for the task; must be non-empty if provided.

fields.name: completed
fields.description: New completion status for the task.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: New priority level for the task.

validators.error_message: Priority must be a positive integer.

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: New due date; set to null to clear, or a YYYY-MM-DD string to set.

types.description: Request body for PATCH /tasks/:id — all fields are optional; only provided fields are updated.

types.name: HttpStatusCode
types.description: The set of HTTP status codes used across the API for consistent response handling.

types.name: ApiErrorResponse

fields.name: status
fields.description: The HTTP status code of the error (e.g. 400, 404).

fields.name: error
fields.description: A human-readable error message describing what went wrong.

types.description: Standard error response body returned by the API for 400 and 404 responses.
